hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Sort candidate intervals by start time in ascending sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: At each coverage milestone, greedily pick the candidate starting within the covered prefix that reaches farthest right.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Repeat until target end is reached or report impossible if no progress can be made.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minIntervalsToCover(clips: list[list[int]], target_start: int, target_end: int) -> int:
    clips.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1]))
    count = 0
    curr_end = target_start
    farthest = target_start
    i = 0
    n = len(clips)

    while curr_end < target_end:
        while i < n and clips[i][0] <= curr_end:
            farthest = max(farthest, clips[i][1])
            i += 1

        if farthest == curr_end:
            return -1  # Cannot advance

        curr_end = farthest
        count += 1

    return count
```
